name: native-source-index-cache
goal: Bound parsed source blobs to the indexed revision while reusing current blobs

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A shared SourceIndexService retains every parsed blob in its map after successive revision indexes; the reusable unit-index coverage needs a many-revision cache-size assertion.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: test/services/unit-index.test.ts exercises source indexing but currently covers one tree per service and does not assert cache retention across revisions; extend its sourceIndex scenario to index 32 revisions and assert only current blobs remain.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: test/services/unit-index/sourceIndex.ts failed at 3c29eb7f4defb22ecd9410e89b5accd24a9a1edc: after successive indexing, parsed cache size was 2 instead of 1 on harbor-mbp-2

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 272129f592 prunes SourceIndexService parsed blobs to the indexed tree and returns compact reason-walk facts

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Regression passed unchanged at 272129f5925c6017ef3931374c1ca0145b41e3db with a bounded one-blob cache across 32 revisions

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
